title: US Announces 45-Day Extension of Israel-Lebanon Ceasefire; Next Talks Scheduled
detail: US State Department spokesperson Tommy Pigott announced that the April 16 ceasefire between Israel and Lebanon had been extended by 45 days, to approximately June 30, 2026, following the conclusion of the Washington talks. The deal established two negotiating tracks: a military/security track meeting at the Pentagon on May 29, and a political track reconvening June 2–3. Lebanon's core demands remained full Israeli withdrawal from all occupied Lebanese territory and a permanent halt to airstrikes; Israel's conditions included credible mechanisms for Hezbollah disarmament south of the Litani River. Hezbollah rejected the negotiations outright, with its leadership declaring the talks and their outcomes unacceptable, casting doubt on the ceasefire's durability. Foreign Policy published analysis titled 'Trump's Lebanon Negotiations Are Breaking the Country', arguing the process was straining Lebanon's internal cohesion.

media.caption: US State Department announces 45-day extension of Israel-Lebanon ceasefire after Washington talks

title: Israeli Strike Kills 7 in Harouf Including 3 Paramedics on Same Day as Ceasefire Extension
detail: Even as the US State Department was announcing a ceasefire extension, an Israeli airstrike struck the town of Harouf in southern Lebanon's Nabatieh district, killing at least 7 people including 3 paramedics. Additional Israeli drone strikes the same day killed 2 people in Nabatieh city and 3 more in a separate strike on Harouf, and 2 in the nearby town of Tabeen. Al Jazeera headlined the stark contradiction: 'Israel kills seven in Lebanon, agrees ceasefire extension.' The killing of first responders drew condemnation from humanitarian organisations. The Lebanon Health Ministry confirmed the paramedic deaths, noting that medical personnel had now become recurring targets of Israeli strikes — a pattern that has drawn repeated protest from the ICRC and WHO throughout the conflict.

media.caption: Israeli strike kills 7 in Harouf including 3 paramedics on the same day a ceasefire extension was announced
